title: Source asset texture/geometry defect review
source: Owner-supplied Assets that require in depth examination and revision.txt, 2026-11-01
scope: Diagnostic review and source-model repair, not speculative replacement
mapping_note: Owner-confirmed ordinal mapping refers to captured archive 13105143372 at source commit 6b9088f. Later catalog fix 4ea2b5f reclassifies Hollow Creek runtime models and changes current numeric capture ordinals; use stable KIND/name focus keys, never renumber the original owner IDs.
review_requirements: Locate each exact numeric ID in the original owner asset index/preview catalog and record the source filename and source hash
Identify whether source is original imported GLB or author-built mesh/Blender scene; preserve original bytes and provenance
Inspect actual original GLB nodes, per-primitive material indices, embedded source images, texture slots, TEXCOORD sets, UV islands, normals/tangents, transforms and backface winding
Compare original source render with in-game actual renderer from matching angles, including a UV-checker debug pass; no web-stock art or generated stand-ins
Repair in original source or make explicit reversible material-preserving derivative; reimport and inspect close-up in development room
Capture before/after actual model PNGs and runtime screenshots, visual checks advisory not build-blocking
Record tested source SHA and runtime asset mapping; mark fixed only after actual render comparison
